title: Sparkly pear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='pearBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d4f56a'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#8fce3a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4f8f1f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pearShine' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f6ffcc' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f6ffcc' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 26 Q49 17 54 11' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M53 16 Q66 6 76 12 Q68 22 53 16 Z' fill='#3fbf5a'/>
  <path d='M55 15 Q64 12 72 13' stroke='#26913c' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- pear body -->
  <path d='M50 26 C40 30 36 42 34 50 C30 62 32 78 42 84 C46 87 54 87 58 84 C68 78 70 62 66 50 C64 42 60 30 50 26 Z' fill='url(#pearBody)'/>

  <!-- lighter edge along the right side for contrast -->
  <path d='M58 84 C68 78 70 62 66 50 C64 42 60 30 52 26 C58 32 61 42 62 50 C64 62 63 76 58 84 Z' fill='#63a82f' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='50' rx='5' ry='11' fill='url(#pearShine)' transform='rotate(-8 43 50)'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6a8'>
    <path d='M20 22 L22 28 L28 30 L22 32 L20 38 L18 32 L12 30 L18 28 Z'/>
    <path d='M82 30 L83.6 34.4 L88 36 L83.6 37.6 L82 42 L80.4 37.6 L76 36 L80.4 34.4 Z'/>
    <path d='M24 70 L25.4 73.6 L29 75 L25.4 76.4 L24 80 L22.6 76.4 L19 75 L22.6 73.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 66 L81.4 69.6 L85 71 L81.4 72.4 L80 76 L78.6 72.4 L75 71 L78.6 69.6 Z'/>
    <path d='M14 46 L15.2 49 L18 50 L15.2 51 L14 54 L12.8 51 L10 50 L12.8 49 Z' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
    <path d='M88 48 L89.2 51 L92 52 L89.2 53 L88 56 L86.8 53 L84 52 L86.8 51 Z' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- little dots sparkle accents -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='16' r='1.8' fill='#fff6a8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#fff6a8'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='90' r='1.8' fill='#a8f0ff'/>
</svg>
